Part 1 - Classes and Methods / ODTransform

ScaleBy

The ScaleBy method scales this transform by the specified vertical and horizontal scaling factors. 
ODTransform ScaleBy (in ODPoint scale);
scale
A point specifying the horizontal (x) and vertical (y) scaling factors.
return value
A reference to this transform after the scaling operation.
